propositions: Blocking LINK events written before comparability became structural remain durable and unresolved on read, causing epic-child cycles and cousin edges to distort ready/next-batch scheduling

The doctor command must scan all net-active blocking edges against the current resolver to classify them as ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable, reusing the reducer's compiled deps[] to avoid replaying LINK/UNLINK

The --repair flag must write replacement links before removing stale ones to ensure interruption leaves a superset the next run converges, and must refuse ambiguous pairs and edges with closed sources

run_repair deadlocks when holding the tracker write lock across multiple writes because each write re-acquires the same non-re-entrant lock; the fix drops the outer lock since replacement-before-unlink provides recovery
Repair must refuse to run while a reconciler pass is in flight and must force-write a pre-doctor-repair tag at the pre-run OID as a rollback anchor
Read-only doctor runs must not trigger store reconvergence by passing init_only=True to ensure_initialized
